newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: TAG Heuer 9-mth net sales up 9.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: TAG Heuer 9-mth net sales up 9.8 pct.

text.p: Swiss watchmaker TAG Heuer International SA THW,N said consolidated net sales rose 9.8 percent in the first nine months of 1996 to 318.7 million Swiss francs from a year earlier.

"This growth rate shows that that the company continues to outperform the Swiss watch industry as a whole, whose watch exports actually declined by 3.4 percent inn terms of value over the first nine months of this year compared to the same period of 1995," it said in a statement.
It said gross margins for the nine-month period was 54.7 percent, up from 54.0 percent in the first half and from 54.2 percent in all of 1995.
Operating income in the first nine months amounted to 21.9 percent of net sales, compared with 22.8 percent in the first six months and 20.2 percent in the year to December 31, 1995.

Net working capital declined by 11.5 million francs in the third quarter, due primarily to lower inventory. This also contributed to a rise of 19.7 million in cash and cash equivalents in the third quarter, the company said.
